title: Stream tonight / Coming soon
slide_intent: Keep changing availability messages recognizable, because viewers should not have to relearn the hierarchy for each promotion.
strategic_value: The repeated italic Stream treatment and inline eyes can preserve Channel 4’s voice across short scheduling statements.
demonstration: Two lines read Stream tonight and Coming soon with an eyes icon, positioned above a cream-to-blue recessed gradient with a pink sliver at left.
practical_value: Decide how to pair a playful anticipation symbol with a concise availability statement.

content_islands.name: Availability copy
content_islands.spec: Place the two black lines at the upper left, with Stream emphasized and eyes following Coming soon.

content_islands.name: Adjacent color worlds
content_islands.spec: Retain the blue recessed field and slim pink neighboring panel to frame the message.

reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram’s accompanying case study describes 4mojis as a way to retain playfulness within a functional graphic system.
reference_purposes.Expression: Two lines read Stream tonight and Coming soon with an eyes icon, positioned above a cream-to-blue recessed gradient with a pink sliver at left.
reference_purposes.Application: The specimen pairs a two-line availability message with an inline eyes icon on a branded gradient background.
